title: Bound eight height-8 copied totals by subspace rank 64
body:
## Summary
- When `U` is contained in `V`, `D_V D_U` equals the operator on `V` intersect `U` perpendicular, and the rank is `dim(V) - dim(U)`. A full 8-dimensional copy has rank 8. A copy of dimensions 6 and 3 has rank 3. A mask outside `V` does not match.
- Eight height-8 totals cost 64. The published two-call centre charge is 32, which is below that mass.
- The selected exponent is unchanged.
